title: The 2027 AI stack for a 5-truck shop (vendor-neutral)

slides.headline: The 2027 AI stack for a 5-truck shop.
slides.body: Vendor-neutral. Price bands included. With "skip it if" warnings — because half of you don't need half of this.

slides.headline: Layer 1 — Missed-call text-back
slides.body:
Rings out → instant text to the caller. The floor. Everybody starts here.
Runs: <$100/mo · Setup: ~15 min
Skip it if: you genuinely answer 95%+ of calls (check the log — almost nobody does).

slides.headline: Layer 2 — After-hours / overflow AI answering
slides.body:
Answers when nobody can, books simple jobs onto the schedule, flags emergencies to on-call.
Runs: $100–$300/mo entry tiers ($1,000+/mo enterprise versions exist — a 5-truck shop doesn't need them)
Skip it if: you have a live answering service that actually BOOKS jobs (most just take messages).

slides.headline: Layer 3 — Estimate follow-up sequences
slides.body:
Auto text+email on day 1/3/7/14 for every open quote. Follow-up roughly doubles typical 25–30% close rates. Biggest dollars on this list.
Runs: $50–$300/mo (often inside software you already own)
Skip it if: you quote fewer than ~5 jobs a month.

slides.headline: Layer 4 — Review engine
slides.body:
Auto-request after every closed job + AI-drafted responses. 91% of homeowners check reviews; the Map Pack pays in free calls.
Runs: free–$150/mo
Skip it if: honestly? Don't skip this one. It compounds.

slides.headline: Layer 5 — List campaigns (the shoulder-season engine)
slides.body:
AI-written seasonal offers + maintenance-agreement pushes to your past customers. Fills February.
Runs: mostly labor, $0–$100/mo in tools
Skip it if: your customer list is under ~100 contacts (fix the list first).

slides.headline: Whole stack: roughly $250–$800/mo. Not $3,000.
slides.body: That's the honest range for a 5-truck shop in 2027. One recovered $8K–$15K changeout funds the entire year. If a rep quotes you four figures monthly, you're buying their sales team, not your stack.

slides.headline: Wrong question: "which tool?" Right question: "which leak first?"
slides.body: The audit tells you the install order for YOUR shop — dollar figure per leak, fixes ranked by payback. DM "AUDIT" or link in bio. December/January slots open; free for my next South Florida shops (normally $497).
